# Davy Keith & Milty Boulter

- [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — Rival of — [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) — rivalry over height · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolhouse antics and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scares her with stories of her deceased relatives. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) take a walk through the woods and accidentally lose their way while heading to a tea party. Their wrong turn leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they meet the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), who invite them to stay for a pretend tea party.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> During breakfast, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discuss Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the situation with [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) and [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), all while managing Davy's lively table manners. [Anne](../character/anne.md) promises to help [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) make an [Indian](../codex/factions.md#indian) headdress using old feathers. Later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund that ensures the twins can remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for a snowbound and lonely [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) vacation, feeling embarrassed by Gilbert's romantic attentions and worried about her finances for her next year at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). While conversing with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and receiving letters brought by Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), she worries about dropping out of college to teach. However, a letter arrives revealing that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/aunt-josephine.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne.md) a thousand dollars in her will, securing her financial future.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) joins [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) outside on a June evening. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) complains about his schoolwork and the local funerals, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) offers to help him with his arithmetic. The conversation turns to local gossip, including Diana's upcoming wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and the town's reaction to [Anne](../character/anne.md) rejecting [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) later wanders down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling melancholic about Gilbert's absence and the changes that growing up brings.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXVIII A June Evening

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) from [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) and learns from her family that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is critically ill with typhoid fever. Keeping a stormy night watch in her room, [Anne](../character/anne.md) realizes she has always loved [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and despairs over her foolishness. In the morning, she meets [Pacifique](../character/pacifique.md) Buote in the yard and learns that Gilbert's fever has broken and he will recover.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XL A Book of Revelation
